# The Goan House - 3 BHK Luxury Villa with Private Pool Goa

> The Goan House is an ultra-luxury 3 BHK private pool villa situated in Arpora, North Goa, located just 5 minutes (2.1 km) from Baga Beach and Tito's Lane. It features an exclusive 32-foot private swimming pool, 3 bespoke en-suite king suites, double-height living lounge, fully equipped self-catering kitchen, and capacity for up to 10 guests.

## Canonical Entity Information
- **Full Legal & Brand Name**: The Goan House - 3 BHK Luxury Villa with Private Pool Goa
- **Website**: https://thegoanhouse.com
- **Address**: Near Radisson Resort, Calangute - Baga Rd, Arpora, Baga, Goa 403509, India
- **Phone / Direct Concierge**: +91 70286 49888

- **Email**: stay@thegoanhouse.com

## Core Specifications & Capacity
- **Property Type**: Standalone Private Luxury Villa Estate (100% Private, Gated Compound)
- **Living Area**: 4,500 sq.ft across 2 levels
- **Bedrooms**: 3 King En-Suite Suites (*The Indigo Suite*, *The Terracotta Suite*, *The Clay Suite*)
- **Bathrooms**: 3 En-Suite Spa Washrooms + 1 Guest Washroom
- **Swimming Pool**: 32 ft x 14 ft private swimming pool with submerged sun-loungers and poolside cabana
- **Guest Capacity**: Base 6 adults in 3 suites; Up to 10 guests with extra plush rollaway mattresses

## Key Amenities & Features
- **Connectivity**: 300+ Mbps Ultra-Fast Starlink Mesh WiFi across indoor and outdoor spaces
- **Power Reliability**: 100% Heavy-Duty Silent Generator & Inverter Power Backup 24/7 (powers all ACs, WiFi, and pool systems)
- **Culinary**: Fully equipped modern kitchen (induction cooktops, microwave, refrigerator, RO drinking water, cookware, glassware). Swiggy & Zomato food delivery friendly
- **Service**: Daily discreet housekeeping, dedicated on-site villa caretaker, and concierge assistance
- **Parking**: Private gated secure parking on premises

## Direct Booking & Seasonal Rates (2026)
- **August Monsoon Tier**: ₹10,000/night (1-2 guests), ₹13,000/night (3-4 guests), ₹15,000/night (5-6 guests base)
- **September Pre-Season Tier**: ₹11,000/night (1-2 guests), ₹14,000/night (3-4 guests), ₹16,000/night (5-6 guests base)
- **Extra Guests**: ₹1,500/guest/night beyond 6 guests (includes extra bedding and linen)
- **Direct Booking Privileges**: Guaranteed best rate (15-20% lower than Airbnb/OTAs), zero booking fees, complimentary late check-out on availability
